name: inspect_desktop_application
description: Inspect a local desktop application directory using bounded listings, file headers and selected metadata. Returns .NET, Unity Mono/IL2CPP, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker and Electron candidates, supporting paths/range hashes, component path markers and concrete next probes. No target execution, extraction, network or target changes. Default summary retains complete Evidence for inspect_analysis_view kind desktop-application; the view supports paging and field selection. detail complete returns every retained fact inline. Snapshot identity covers examined metadata/read ranges, not all file contents; coverage and unavailable probes remain explicit.
